what_is_it.explanation: GoLive is an open-source agent skill and zero-dependency Node CLI that helps take agent-built products live on a developer's own accounts. It follows a structured flow of detect, plan, approve, apply, and verify without relying on a GoLive backend, account, or telemetry. It operates using supported configurations for hosting, databases, domains, email, and payments.
what_is_it.one_line: An open-source agent skill and zero-dependency Node CLI to take agent-built products live.
